'''Queesh''' was one of the two continents on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]]. It was the location of the [[Communal Pool]], the political center of the [[Ergesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Behind the scenes==
Throughout ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]'', the Queesh continent is also spelled '''"Quesh"''' and '''"Quash"'''.
